meta.title: Add unified performance message support to ntttcp test cases
meta.body_summary: Add unified performance message support for ntttcp, sending standardized metrics alongside existing TCP/UDP messages, with configurable relativity, units, and protocol type.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot iterated on unified perf messages with 28 inline reviews; maintainer feedback on relativity, units, and protocol_type; merged after 2 approvals.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 1231 changed lines, this is a medium-sized feature addition, concentrated in ntttcp.py. As a feature to enable standardized metric reporting, it merged after iterative review, with removal of duplication and alignment with existing patterns, consistent with a successful merge.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainers LiliDeng and squirrelsc provided 26 inline comments focusing on MetricRelativity (HigherIsBetter/LowerIsBetter), metric unit correctness (KB vs bytes, removal of units from packet counts), code duplication refactoring, and proper placement of protocol_type in PerfMessage base class.
review_details.performance_claim: Enable unified performance message reporting for ntttcp test cases, improving data analysis capabilities and standardizing metrics across the LISA framework.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Copilot successfully navigated a lengthy iterative review on a feature addition, aligning with maintainer preferences on relativity, units, and protocol_type placement, demonstrating capability when the change pattern is well-established (following PR #3862).

detection_detail.code_reading: LiliDeng and squirrelsc read the diff and requested MetricRelativity values, unit corrections (KB vs bytes), removal of units from packet counts, and code refactoring to reduce duplication.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR includes test instructions and unit test claims, but no CI test results provided; flake8 formatting issues caught by maintainers via manual review.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: All feedback addressed in subsequent commits within the PR; no revert needed.

core_change_summary.description: In lisa/tools/ntttcp.py, added helper method _send_unified_perf_metrics and methods send_ntttcp_tcp_unified_perf_messages and send_ntttcp_udp_unified_perf_messages to send standardized performance metrics via send_unified_perf_message. Updated lisa/messages.py to include protocol_type in PerfMessage. Modified iperf3.py to remove unused TransportProtocol import. Adjusted common.py initially to call unified messages, then moved calls into create methods per review.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: messages.py added protocol_type field; common.py wiring adjusted and later removed from test suite; iperf3.py import cleanup.
change_trajectory: Initial implementation added unified messages in ntttcp.py.
Aligned with PR #3862 pattern per LiliDeng's reference.
Added MetricRelativity support after first inline review.
Refactored to reduce code duplication with helper method _send_unified_perf_metrics.
Moved call sites into create methods per squirrelsc's review.
Added protocol_type support and set default to None.
Added MetricUnit support for metrics, then corrected units (KB vs bytes, removed units from rx_packets, tx_packets, pkts_interrupts).
Attempted to set protocol_type as metric, then reverted to keep in PerfMessage base class.
Added protocol_type field to TCP performance message; maintainer set protocol type for other messages.
Final cleanup of unused import in iperf3.py.

review_signals.action_taken: Copilot added MetricRelativity support to all unified metrics in commit b22ab46.

review_signals.summary: buffer_size unit should be KB, not bytes, because ntttcp uses -b with K suffix.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot changed unit from 'bytes' to 'KB' in commit b07e085.

review_signals.summary: rx_packets and tx_packets have no unit; pkts_interrupts has no unit.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot removed units from those metrics in commit f0a224f.

review_signals.summary: Set protocol_type on PerfMessage base class to tcp or udp so the protocol type is saved for messages.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot added protocol_type field to PerfMessage and set it appropriately in commits a3552d8 and 7847fde.

review_signals.summary: Refactor to avoid repeated code in TCP and UDP unified message methods.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot created _send_unified_perf_metrics helper and reduced code by ~35% in commit 47468f7.

review_signals.summary: Move unified message calls into create methods instead of calling in common.py.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot moved calls to ntttcp create methods in commit 765e300.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened PR with initial unified message implementation.
LiliDeng requested alignment with PR #3862 pattern; Copilot updated.
Maintainer inline reviews requested MetricRelativity; Copilot added support.
LiliDeng asked for code refactoring to reduce duplication; Copilot created helper method.
squirrelsc requested moving call sites and setting protocol_type; Copilot implemented.
Multiple rounds of metric unit corrections (KB, packet unit removal) led by LiliDeng.
Discussion on protocol_type as metric vs field settled on base class field.
LiliDeng requested flake8 fixes and final touchups; PR approved by LiliDeng and squirrelsc; merged.
